original_description:
### Valerian Root 100gm | Pure, Wild-Harvested Ayurvedic Herb for Daily Wellness

Rooted in tradition, Valerian Root (Valeriana officinalis) is a revered herb in ancient healing systems, valued for its gentle, grounding nature. Sourced with care and dried using time-honored methods, Falcon Herbs’ Valerian Root is 100% pure — no additives, no fillers, just the natural essence of the herb.

In Ayurvedic practice, this herb has long been used as part of daily rituals to support a calm, balanced state of being. Its subtle aroma and earthy profile make it a cherished companion in moments of quiet reflection, evening rituals, or mindful unwinding.

Whether blended into warm herbal infusions, incorporated into herbal powders, or used in traditional preparations, Valerian Root offers a naturally soothing presence — helping to harmonize the senses and support a tranquil rhythm to your day.

Why Choose Falcon Herbs Valerian Root?
- Wild-harvested & sun-dried for maximum purity
- No chemicals, no preservatives, no synthetic additives
- Certified organic and ethically sourced
- Ideal for home herbal preparations — teas, decoctions, churnas, or capsules

Store in a cool, dry place. Use as part of your wellness routine, in alignment with your personal rhythm and lifestyle.

For best results, consult with a qualified Ayurvedic practitioner to understand how this herb may suit your constitution.
